name: Uptime Kuma
description: Get alerted when a website, device or service at home stops responding.

afterInstall.text: Click Open. When asked which database to use, choose SQLite: it is the simplest choice and works well at home.
Click Add New Monitor, choose what to watch (a website, a device address) and how often to check it.
Under Settings, then Notifications, connect the app you want alerts on (email, Telegram and many others).
